learner_prompt.text: I keep mixing up negative reinforcement and punishment. How do I tell them apart?

tutor_response.text: Focus on two questions: is something being added or removed, and is the behavior meant to increase or decrease? Reinforcement always increases a behavior â€” negative reinforcement does so by removing an aversive stimulus, such as fastening a seatbelt to stop the warning chime. Punishment always decreases a behavior â€” for example, a traffic fine intended to reduce speeding. So 'negative' in negative reinforcement means subtraction of a stimulus, not something bad happening to the learner.
